title: Review big Plans one checkpoint at a time
reference: Trevor's product direction, 2026-11-03 to 2026-11-05: "we have plans that have over 200 tasks spread over 6 phases. I feel like we might need some kind of way to indicate critical milestones so it's not a big fat one shot for stuff that's huge." "What's important there is that we define what is reviewable sanely. And once we pass review we continue on. I think that will mean the plan needs to be flexible somewhat that we might change on review." "Each of these checkpoints will create a review of the work thus far. The review should show the tasks completed on this layout and what's to come. What stories are being addressed in the checkpoint." On questions: the review covers what changed since the last checkpoint, going further back is discretionary; passing means the work can continue in a new workspace; passing is at the discretion of whoever invokes the Plan, who can say pass the checkpoints unless something is particularly surprising or urgent; Tasks past an unpassed checkpoint are held back with a warning; size is measured by Change Saga itself: does it need 10 to 20 slides to explain, or are 5 to 6 sufficient.
